sinopsis.es: Un verano caluroso en una ciudad asediada por cortes de luz. Un barrio privado con un gigantesco parque. Un terreno aledaño abandonado y una ola incontrolable de humo desatan la incertidumbre y el caos.
sinopsis.en: Buenos Aires, during the summer heart, in gated communities surrounded by wastelands covered with trash. The barking of stray dogs, repeated power outages, and uncontrollable clouds of smoke drive the inhabitants to confront their most primitive instincts.
